description: IRF World Road Statistics provides World Road Statistics and its data warehouse with road networks, traffic, fleets, accidents and infrastructure finances. The provider is International Road Federation. Geographical and temporal coverage: The provider identifies a 2026 edition covering 2019 to 2024, more than 200 countries and more than 200 indicators. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Free access is stated for the data warehouse. It does not establish free rights to every publication or unrestricted redistribution. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
